small_features.title: Implement MiniMax text-to-music Audio node
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can turn lyrics or connected script text into one playable audio outcome node from a Script-style inline Audio composer on the canvas, with backend-confirmed MiniMax provider/model evidence and honest local-preview labeling.
acceptance_criteria: Audio source nodes expose a Script-style inline composer for music style prompt and lyrics text under the selected Audio node.
Lyrics can be typed manually and can be seeded from connected upstream script/storyboard output when available.
Generate posts to the local FastAPI backend and never exposes MiniMax credentials in frontend code.
Backend MiniMax config uses MINIMAX_API_KEY, MINIMAX_BASE_URL, MINIMAX_MUSIC_MODEL, and optional MINIMAX_HTTPS_PROXY, defaulting the model to music-2.6-free.
Provider code posts to the MiniMax music_generation API with prompt, lyrics, output_format, audio_setting, lyrics_optimizer, and is_instrumental fields.
A successful generation creates or updates one deterministic audio outcome node on the canvas with a single audio output port.
The audio outcome node renders browser playback controls from a returned URL or hex/base64 audio data and displays provider/model evidence.
Unavailable Audio-node functions are explicitly labeled through visible not-implemented or no-persistence messages.
Verification covers backend provider/route tests, frontend tests, typecheck/build, and rendered interaction or E2E evidence.
